title: Coordinate retention pair distribution
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite type, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $\rho\in[0,1]$. The coordinate retention pair distribution on $\Omega\times\Omega$ is obtained by drawing $x$ according to $\pi$, then drawing $y$ from the coordinate product noise distribution with base law $\pi$, retention parameter $\rho$, and input $x$, and returning $(x,y)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
